question: ‘The Autobiography of an Unknown Indian’ is the autobiography of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Nirad C. Chaudhuri.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Autobiography of an Unknown Indian is the 1951 autobiography of Indian writer **Nirad C.** **Chaudhuri**.
 
• **Written when he was around 50**, it records his life from his** birth in 1897 in Kishoreganj, a small town in present-day Bangladesh.**
 
• Nirad Chandra Chaudhuri CBE was** an Indian writer.**
 
• In **1990**,** Oxford University awarded** Chaudhuri, by then a long-time resident of the city of Oxford,** an Honorary Degree in Letters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dde5d9de26cd6dbc570e326e9a960169ecf72f7bbd0f9696c4308767d4c4dcf3.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swaminatha Iyer **published his autobiography, **En Saritham**, serialised in the** Tamil weekly Ananda Vikatan,** from January **1940 to May 1942**. 
 
• **Justice Anna Chandy**, also known as **Anna Chandi, **was the **first female judge and then High Court judge in India.**
 
• **Inder Kumar Gujral **was **an Indian diplomat, politician and freedom activist **who served as the **12th prime minister of India from April 1997 to March 1998.**
